description: This file implements Bluetooth GATT server socket functionality, including deserialization of attributes, handling of Bluetooth socket commands, security settings, and state changes within the WPEFramework Bluetooth namespace.

classes.name: Attribute
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth attribute with deserialization capabilities.

classes.name: GATTSocket
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth GATT socket with command processing, security, and state management.

methods.name: Attribute::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes attribute data from a byte stream.

methods.name: GATTSocket::Command::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a command from a byte stream, handling various Bluetooth ATT protocol responses.

methods.name: GATTSocket::Security
methods.description: Sets the security level for the Bluetooth socket connection.

methods.name: GATTSocket::StateChange
methods.description: Handles socket state changes, including connection info retrieval and timeout management.
